reason: I'd try the free tricks on my kids, maybe, but I basically never pay for apps, and 99 shekels for something I'd probably fumble in front of the family isn't happening. Installing from a browser instead of the App Store and paying by card on some website also makes me hesitate.
objection: I'm not a magician. If I mess up the trick in front of everyone it's embarrassing, and then I've paid 99 shekels for nothing.
would_change_my_mind: If the free tricks were so easy that I actually pulled one off and the kids went wild, I might pay, but only at a much lower price, like 30 or 40 shekels.
